jonah_cast_overboard.prompt: storm-lashed wooden merchant ship on towering dark waves, sailors mid-heave casting a wild-haired prophet over the rail toward the sea, lightning-lit spray, vertical, 8th-century BC Mediterranean

great_fish_rising.prompt: a vast dark great fish rising through deep blue-black water beneath a small sinking robed man, columns of pale light from the surface far above, trails of bubbles, vertical

storm_ship_waves.prompt: a small wooden merchant ship heeling on towering deep-teal storm swells under a black night sky, whitecaps breaking over the deck, tiny sailors clinging to the rigging, driving rain, vertical, 8th-century BC Mediterranean

nineveh_distant_walls.prompt: a massive walled city on a wide plain at dusk, high gates and stepped towers, warm lamplight inside the walls, seen from a distant ridge, vertical, ancient Assyria

lot_falls_jonah.prompt: storm-drenched sailors crouching over small dark pebble lots scattered on the wet deck planks of a pitching ship, one sailor turning to point at the wild-haired prophet standing back in a plain rain-soaked robe, lightning glare, vertical, 8th-century BC Mediterranean

jonah_sinking_down.prompt: a robed prophet sinking down through dark green-blue deep water, arms drifting up toward the wavering bright surface and a small ship hull far above, bubbles rising, vertical

jonah_in_the_deep.prompt: a gaunt prophet in a ragged olive-green robe kneeling in prayer in shallow water on the floor of a vast dark living cavern of flesh, curved rib arches overhead vanishing into blackness, faint cold teal light around him, vertical

jesus_and_scribes.prompt: Jesus standing calm before a huddle of robed scribes and Pharisees gesturing in demand among temple columns, his face steady in warm light, vertical, 1st-century Judea

three_days_dark_tomb.prompt: a linen-shrouded body lying still on a stone ledge inside a dark rock-cut tomb chamber that fills the whole frame, one thin shaft of cold light from the entrance seam, vertical, 1st-century Judea

body_laid_in_tomb.prompt: inside a small rock-cut tomb chamber, two robed men gently lowering a linen-shrouded body onto a low waist-high stone ledge cut along the wall, a small clay oil lamp on the floor casting warm light up the rough rock, vertical, 1st-century Judea

stone_rolled_dawn.prompt: seen from inside the empty rock-cut tomb, the great round stone rolled aside from the bright doorway, dawn light flooding across the bare stone ledge with only flat linen grave clothes lying on it, vertical, 1st-century Judea

jonah_on_shore.prompt: a drenched wild-haired prophet on hands and knees on a wet beach at dawn, seaweed strands on his ragged robe, gentle surf receding behind him, warm light breaking, vertical

risen_christ_wounds.prompt: the risen Christ standing in radiant dawn light in a garden, white robe, both hands open toward the viewer showing the wounds in his palms, serene living face, vertical, 1st-century Judea

mercy_hand_into_deep.prompt: a strong weathered open hand reaching down through the surface of dark deep water, fingers spread wide, golden light streaming around it toward a dim sunken figure far below, vertical

man_rising_from_water.prompt: a man seen from behind in dark silhouette bursting up through the surface of deep water into blinding golden morning light, arms flung wide, spray flying off him, vertical

dips_meta.phrase: my name: For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale's belly; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart

cta_meta.phrase: that is how far His mercy reaches. It cost Him the grave. Stop running, and turn: the One who went down into your dark and rose again is Jesus. Come up out of the deep, and live.

register.palette: inked cel-flat, storm blue-blacks and deep teal to tomb dark to dawn gold
register.mood: the deep, the sign, the rising

jonah_cast_overboard.subject: sailors casting the prophet from a storm-lashed ship
jonah_cast_overboard.doctrine: they took up Jonah and cast him forth into the sea (Jonah 1:15)

great_fish_rising.subject: a great fish rising beneath the sinking prophet
great_fish_rising.doctrine: the LORD had prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah (Jonah 1:17)

storm_ship_waves.subject: a small ship heeling on mountainous storm waves
storm_ship_waves.doctrine: the LORD sent out a great wind into the sea (Jonah 1:4)

nineveh_distant_walls.subject: the walled city of Nineveh at dusk from a distant ridge
nineveh_distant_walls.doctrine: go to Nineveh, that great city (Jonah 1:2)

lot_falls_jonah.subject: sailors around the cast lots, every face on the prophet
lot_falls_jonah.doctrine: they cast lots, and the lot fell upon Jonah (Jonah 1:7)

jonah_sinking_down.subject: the prophet sinking through the deep, ship hull far above
jonah_sinking_down.doctrine: thou hadst cast me into the deep (Jonah 2:3)

jonah_in_the_deep.subject: the prophet praying inside the great fish's belly
jonah_in_the_deep.doctrine: then Jonah prayed unto the LORD his God out of the fish's belly (Jonah 2:1)

jesus_and_scribes.subject: Jesus calm before demanding scribes and Pharisees
jesus_and_scribes.doctrine: an evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign (Matt 12:39)

three_days_dark_tomb.subject: shrouded body on a ledge in a dark rock-cut tomb
three_days_dark_tomb.doctrine: so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth (Matt 12:40)

body_laid_in_tomb.subject: the body laid gently on the tomb ledge by two men

stone_rolled_dawn.subject: the stone rolled aside, dawn light bursting from the tomb

jonah_on_shore.subject: the prophet cast up on the beach at dawn
jonah_on_shore.doctrine: it vomited out Jonah upon the dry land (Jonah 2:10)

risen_christ_wounds.subject: the risen Christ showing the wounds in his open palms
risen_christ_wounds.doctrine: he shewed unto them his hands and his side (John 20:20)

mercy_hand_into_deep.subject: a wounded hand reaching down into dark water toward a sunken figure
mercy_hand_into_deep.doctrine: mercy reaching into the deep — yet will I look again toward thy holy temple (Jonah 2:4)

man_rising_from_water.subject: a man bursting up from dark water into morning light
man_rising_from_water.doctrine: come up out of the deep and live — He brought up my life from corruption (Jonah 2:6)
